title: Sacrifices Pleasing to God, Final Greetings

questions.question: Do not neglect to show hospitality to ____, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:2 (ESV): "Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares."

questions.question: Remember those who are in ____, as though in ____ with them, and those who are mistreated, since you also are in the body.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:3 (ESV): "Remember those who are in prison, as though in prison with them, and those who are mistreated, since you also are in the body."

questions.question: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the marriage ____ be undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterous.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:4 (ESV): "Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the marriage bed be undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterous."

questions.question: Keep your life free from love of ____, and be content with what you have, for he has said, "I will never leave you nor forsake you."
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:5 (ESV): "Keep your life free from love of money, and be content with what you have, for he has said, 'I will never leave you nor forsake you.'"

questions.question: So we can confidently say, "The Lord is my ____; I will not fear; what can man do to me?"
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:6 (ESV): "So we can confidently say, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not fear; what can man do to me?'"

questions.question: Remember your ____, those who spoke to you the word of God. Consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:7 (ESV): "Remember your leaders, those who spoke to you the word of God. Consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith."

questions.question: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and ____ and forever.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:8 (ESV): "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever."

questions.question: Do not be led away by diverse and strange ____, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods...
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:9 (ESV): "Do not be led away by diverse and strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, which have not benefited those devoted to them."

questions.question: Through him then let us continually offer up a sacrifice of ____ to God, that is, the fruit of lips that acknowledge his name.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:15 (ESV): "Through him then let us continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that acknowledge his name."

questions.question: Do not neglect to do ____ and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:16 (ESV): "Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God."

questions.question: Obey your ____ and submit to them, for they are keeping watch over your souls, as those who will have to give an account.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:17 (ESV): "Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they are keeping watch over your souls, as those who will have to give an account. Let them do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be of no advantage to you."

questions.question: Now may the God of peace who brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great ____ of the sheep, by the blood of the eternal covenant,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:20 (ESV): "Now may the God of peace who brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of the eternal covenant,"

questions.question: equip you with everything ____ that you may do his will, working in us that which is pleasing in his sight...
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:21 (ESV): "equip you with everything good that you may do his will, working in us that which is pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen."

questions.question: You should know that our brother ____ has been released, with whom I shall see you if he comes soon.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 13:23 (ESV): "You should know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom I shall see you if he comes soon."

key_verse_text: Through him then let us continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that acknowledge his name.
